notes.title: Patch 1.1.2.0
notes.content:
This update is aiming to make the player experience even better. Some systems have been reworked and more accessibility options were added:
- Added vibration and screenshake options.
- Added directions to certain areas.
- Fixed a bug that displayed both the keyboard and the controller interaction key on sign messages.
- Added an animation when the player sets a new Recall.
- Completely turned off the Thunder Charge mana cost. Feel free to spam it.
- Enemies drop more mana on kill. 
- Small map changes on Hollow Mountains and Swallower's Retreat.

notes.title: The Hunt Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41878051/3eb1aaaef9e9da5fd282c86209aa44e0d3e52c7a.png[/img]
[h1]Join the hunt![/h1]
[h2]Witch hunter put on your Cape and sharpen your sword![/h2]
Follow the hero into this epic adventure and guide him through a magical world. As the last Crimson Cape you will be called to face challenges that nobody has overcome before. Hunt witches and slay monsters, defeat powerful bosses and take their powers!
[h2]Find out the real version of the events from the unreliable narrator. [/h2]
In Windmills you will live through a story that evolves and adapts according to the choices you make. Depending on how you play the game, events will unfold differently. Did the hero actually live through these adventures or is he telling tall tales? 
[h2]Join the Crimson Capes.[/h2]
Click the link to join the Official Discord Server and join the clan of the Crimson Capes: http://discord.gg/DD4JW2bQ8F
You will find a community of experienced and friendly players that will help you through your travels in the world of Windmills.
